description: Canonical list of third-party dependencies probed from mainland China. One object per dependency.

services.name: Google Fonts
services.symptom: Fallback typeface and layout shift while the page waits for fonts that never arrive.

services.name: Material Symbols
services.symptom: Icon glyphs render as empty boxes or raw ligature text when the icon font never loads.

services.name: Adobe Fonts (Typekit)
services.symptom: Text falls back to system fonts; branded type and weights never apply.

services.name: Google reCAPTCHA
services.symptom: The CAPTCHA widget never renders, so forms and sign-up cannot be submitted.

services.name: Auth0
services.symptom: The login widget stalls or loads slowly, delaying or blocking sign-in.

services.name: Google Sign-In
services.symptom: The Google sign-in button never appears, locking out that login path.

services.name: Google Tag Manager
services.symptom: Tag Manager fails to load, so downstream tags and events never fire.

services.name: Google Analytics 4
services.symptom: Analytics never initializes; pageviews and events go uncollected.

services.name: YouTube embed
services.symptom: The video area stays blank/black — player chrome and thumbnail never load.

services.name: Google Maps
services.symptom: The map collapses into an empty grey box with no tiles or controls.

services.name: Vimeo embed
services.symptom: The Vimeo player stays blank — the embed iframe never finishes loading.
